items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I was with Bobby Stark and Dickie Wells was over here.

ctx.x: 1933, because December 18th, 1933, I will never forget Fletcher Henderson's band coming to Kansas City and Herschel Evans and Lester Young with Ben Webster at the Cherry Blossoms Ballroom, when Coleman Hawkins got drunk and Dickie Wells was right there and laughed at him.
A great player. Because of his trombone playing.
